title: angelica sylvestris var. litoralis
intro: Angelica sylvestris var. litoralis, commonly known as sea angelica, is a subspecies of the angelica plant, which is a perennial herb that grows in coastal and mountainous areas. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and alleviate respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of sea angelica include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in relieving coughs, colds, and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of sea angelica include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
